quote.text:
Enough of dreams! No longer mock The burdened hearts of men! Not on the cloud, but on the rock Build thou thy faith again;

O range no more the realms of air, Stoop to the glen-bound streams; Thy hope was all too like despair: Enough, enough of dreams.
quote.author: Alfred Noyes

history.text: With the Grito de Dolores, Father Miguel Hidalgo begins Mexico's fight for independence from Spain.
